title: Nourishing Kenyan Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and comforting soup inspired by Kenyan cuisine, perfect for a chilly evening. This dish combines the goodness of vermicelli noodles with a variety of nutritious ingredients.
instructions: Heat the nourishing broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the vermicelli noodles and roasted vegetables to the pot.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the noodles are tender.
Stir in the fresh spinach and cook until wilted.
Optional: Add a splash of lemon juice or a sprinkle of chopped fresh herbs for extra flavor.
